## PHARYNGITIS AND TONSILLITIS
Most cases are viral, primarily due to adenovirus. Aside from streptococcal and
gonococcal pharyngitis, antimicrobials are not indicated. For gonococcal
pharyngitis, use link below for recommendations.
[Treatment of Gonorrheal Infections](orzc-gmenu-abx-gonococcal)
Consider HIV screening for patients with pharyngitis
HIV Rapid Test
## Streptococcal Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis
Diagnosis of group A streptococcal (GAS) infection is made through detection by
rapid PCR and should be reserved for patients who have a moderate to high risk
of GAS infection according to the Modified Centor Score. Use link below for
Modified Centor score criteria and for more details.
[More About Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis and Modified Centor score](orzc-gmenu-more-about-pharyngitis)
[Rapid Strep A throat PCR testing lab order](lrtz-strep-a-pcr)
## PCR Negative, Viral and Other Non-GAS Causes of Pharyngitis Treatment
Antimicrobials are not indicated
## GAS Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis Treatment
Preferred
[Penicillin V 500 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]](psjzid-penicillin-v-500-mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Benzathine penicillin 1.2 million units IM x 1 ($$$) [M]](psjzid-benzathine-penicillin-1-2mu-im-once)
Primary alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]](psjzid-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-q12h)
Secondary alternative, after assessment of beta-lactam reaction above:
